summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Scorpio Tankers Inc. to report the results of its 2026 annual meeting of shareholders. At the meeting, shareholders elected three Class I directors and ratified the appointment of PricewaterhouseCoopers Audit as independent auditors for FY2026. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change is disclosed. The filing is a standard current report of a foreign private issuer and does not trigger any special-situation classification.
